title: Maker workshop
brief: The original delivery of six boxes of unpowered workshop kits to classroom reception has fallen through. The community center needs a replacement shipment in time for the first workshop. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text: I have all six boxes of unpowered workshop kits packed and can release them for pickup at 10:30 or later today. All six need to travel together to classroom reception. Robin, when can you receive them, and what’s the latest they can arrive before the workshop? Casey, please check availability and pricing for that window. Morgan, what budget can you approve?

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text: I can guarantee a staffed handover at classroom reception through 12:15 today, including right at 12:15. All six boxes need to arrive together, and someone must be there to receive them. Quinn, when can the full load be ready? Casey, can you quote a service that guarantees handover by 12:15? Morgan, please confirm what we can approve so we can book it.

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text: I can approve up to 92 crowns including all fees. All six boxes must travel together to classroom reception. Quinn, when and where can Casey collect them? Robin, when can you receive them, and what’s the latest arrival that works for the first workshop? Casey, please quote a service you can book today that fits both windows. I’ll confirm approval here.

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
I can book all six boxes together. Today’s quotes in crowns, with pickup and guaranteed staffed handover times, are V869 (10:27, by 11:30, 57), V719 (10:40, by 12:09, 44), V695 (10:50, by 11:39, 73) and V997 (10:54, by 11:36, 107).

Quinn, when will all six boxes be ready? Robin, what’s the staffed reception window and the latest handover that works for the workshop? Morgan, what spend can you approve? I’ll book the lowest-priced service that fits.
